answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded to a hardware-attested key before it can earn. Like water carving a karst, honest work slowly erodes the barrier to trust, while a forged swarm must fund each identity upfront. Peers attest from a shared ledger and misbehavior burns the bond, so a sybil attacker gains no cheap foothold on the knoll: each clone pays full freight. Standing on that ledge of staked capital, mass impersonation costs more than it can ever extract.
